# Claim

A single typed data item stored in the vault, individually addressable for field-level consent

> **Goal:** Store personal data with source provenance and verification status, using schema.org vocabulary types

## Fields

| Name | Type | Required | PII | Description |
| ---- | ---- | -------- | --- | ----------- |
| `id` | uuid | yes |  |  |
| `ownerId` | uuid | yes |  |  |
| `type` | string | yes |  | schema.org or W3C VC type, e.g. "schema:givenName", "schema:birthDate" |
| `value` | json | yes | ✓ | Encrypted claim payload; plaintext never persisted unencrypted |
| `source` | enum (`self-attested`, `issuer-signed`, `imported`) | yes |  | Provenance of this claim |
| `verification` | enum (`none`, `self`, `verified`) | yes |  | Verification level |
| `issuedAt` | timestamp | yes |  |  |
| `expiresAt` | timestamp | no |  | Optional expiry; null means no expiry |
| `issuerDid` | string | no | ✓ | DID of the external issuer if source=issuer-signed |

| Name | Kind | Target | Foreign Key |
| ---- | ---- | ------ | ----------- |
| `owner` | belongsTo | `VaultUser` | `ownerId` |
